newFinding.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Restore focus when resizing closes the mobile menu**

When an open menu crosses from 980px to 981px, this closes it while focus remains on a navigation link; if the viewport then returns to mobile width, the new `visibility:hidden` rule hides that focused link and leaves keyboard focus invisible or reset. This occurs during tablet rotation or split-screen resizing, and the same `setOpen(false)` resize path in `ru/coffee-gazipasa.html` has the defect. Move focus to a control that remains visible across the breakpoint, or explicitly restore it when re-entering the mobile layout.
